text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан fights hard, but in the end,
she can't
match Огури Кэп, who is a cut
above the rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... It was no use... I thought I had it, but Oguri kept on going...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
That power... What an amazing race...
Did she
mean for it to play out like that?
Is she just that
talented?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you, Trainer. I'm... sorry I
couldn't win
it.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
She was so strong. This is what a
superstar is
really like.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: You did good out there too.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Огури Кэп?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I never expected a classic-year racer to
make it
here.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Let's do it again next year. Same time,
same
place. I'm excited to see your
progress.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
O-of course! It would be an honor,
Oguri!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
And I'm going to keep improving, even
more than
you do. 'Cause I'm hungry to
win.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Huh? O-okay...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
After strangely declaring her next win,
Oguri Cap
walks away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer, look at me. My legs...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I can't stop shaking. She's such a funny
person,
but she scares me too...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ryan's legs are trembling. It's just like
when she
was afraid of Мэдзиро МакКуин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I thought I got a little stronger, but I still
have so
far to go...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna sulk about it, though!
Gotta pump
up for next year!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list:
Right. What race do you want to set as your
goal?

text_block_list.text:
My next goal... Actually, I've already
come to a
decision about that.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I wanna enter the spring Tenno Sho! I'll
use this
experience in a race against
McQueen, so please
help me prepare for
it!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I give her a big nod. Today's race is
going to
serve as a great source of
motivation for her next
competition.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho—her rematch with
Mejiro
McQueen will surely be a battle
to remember.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
